Warehouse Layout.text_excerpt:
Topology read from locations.csv: 9 zones · 36 aisles · 144 racks · 2,304 bins · 4 shelf levels (golden levels [1, 2]) · usable volume 430.6 m³. Showing the optimized assignment (switch the detail layout in the sidebar to compare). Aisle connections and cross-aisles are modeled in the routing graph (aisle-entrance and zone-hub nodes); the plan draws the aisle bands.

Warehouse Layout: 3x3 Matrix with 9 Zones & Edge Racks

All nine zones (Z1 to Z9) are enclosed in a 40.8m x 40.8m box. Each zone has 4 edge racks on its 4 sides (South, North, West, East) with inter-zone corridors running strictly between them.

Experiments.text_excerpt:
Controlled experiments — Phases 3 & 4

Every value below is read from outputs/phase3/phase3_experiments.json and outputs/phase4/phase4_experiments.json through the existing contracts. The dashboard does not recompute metrics. Phase 3 travel is a demand-weighted order-line metric (metres / resolved line); Phase 4 travel is simulated batch-route distance. They are different metrics and are not combined.
